name: M3_PDS013MI_GetAltMat
description: Retrieve alternate material details for a specific product structure component line. This operation returns one alternate component defined for a product and facility, identified by facility, product number, product structure type, sequence number, and alternate material. Alternate materials represent component items that can replace the main component in the bill of material under defined conditions. The response includes identity and description, validity from date and priority, quantity and unit-of-measure settings, issue method, normal waste percentage, attribute number, text identity, and quantity relation so that user interfaces and integrations can display or validate the complete alternate material definition.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the alternate material record is defined.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number whose product structure includes the alternate material record.

inputParameters.name: STRT
inputParameters.description: Product structure type for which the alternate material record is defined.

inputParameters.name: MSEQ
inputParameters.description: Sequence number identifying the material line in the product structure for this alternate material record.

inputParameters.name: MTAL
inputParameters.description: Item number of the alternate component in the product structure.

inputParameters.name: FDAT
inputParameters.description: Start date from which the alternate material record is valid.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility to which this alternate material record belongs.

outputParameters.name: PRNO
outputParameters.description: Product whose product structure includes this alternate material.

outputParameters.name: STRT
outputParameters.description: Product structure type for which this alternate material is defined.

outputParameters.name: MSEQ
outputParameters.description: Sequence number of the material line in the product structure to which this alternate material belongs.

outputParameters.name: MTAL
outputParameters.description: Item number of the alternate component used instead of the main component.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Name or description of the alternate component item.

outputParameters.name: FDAT
outputParameters.description: Start date from which this alternate material record is valid.

outputParameters.name: PREX
outputParameters.description: Priority of this alternate material compared to other alternatives for the same component.

outputParameters.name: CNQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity of the alternate component used in the product structure.

outputParameters.name: PEUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure used to express the alternate component quantity in the product structure.

outputParameters.name: DCCD
outputParameters.description: Number of decimal places used when processing the component quantity for this alternate material.

outputParameters.name: SPMT
outputParameters.description: Method used to issue the alternate component to manufacturing or work orders.

outputParameters.name: WAPC
outputParameters.description: Expected scrap or waste percentage for the alternate component.

outputParameters.name: ATNR
outputParameters.description: Attribute number associated with this alternate material, if attribute-controlled.

outputParameters.name: TXID
outputParameters.description: Identifier for any text or comments linked to this alternate material line.

outputParameters.name: FXCD
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the alternate component quantity is fixed regardless of the order quantity.
